newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds closed firmer in line with Chicago.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds closed firmer in line with Chicago.

text.p: UK meals and feeds closed firmer in line with gains seen on Chicago soybean meal futures on Wednesday, although with most traders sidelined.
Traders preferred to sit it out until they were sure whether the Chicago move would be sustained and if so, they wanted to see how far it would go before getting involved.
Early indications from Chicago point to further gains in the UK on Friday.
Soybean meal selling levels closed as much as 8.50 stg higher. No trade was reported in any sector of the UK meals and feeds market. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8074
